passages.text:
Subject: Outstanding Invoice #4821

Dear Mr. Tanaka,

Our records show that invoice #4821, issued on March 3 for consulting services in February, has not yet been paid. The original deadline was March 31. The total amount due is $4,800.

If payment has already been sent, please disregard this message. Otherwise, we would appreciate settlement by April 15. Payments made after that date are subject to a two percent late fee.

Please note that our banking details changed on April 1. The updated account information is listed on our website under "Billing".

Sincerely,
Ruth Mbeki
Accounts Receivable, Halden Consulting

Subject: RE: Outstanding Invoice #4821

Dear Ms. Mbeki,

Thank you for the reminder. I checked with our finance department this morning. The payment was submitted on March 28, but it was sent to the account listed on the invoice itself.

Could you confirm whether that transfer reached you? If it did not, we will arrange a second transfer to the updated account this week. We would like to avoid the late fee you mentioned, since the original payment was made before the stated deadline.

Best regards,
Kenji Tanaka
Operations, Sanwa Foods

subQuestions.question: What is the purpose of the first email?

choices.text: To announce a change in consulting fees
To confirm that a payment has been received
To offer a discount on future services
To request payment for a service already provided

subQuestions.explanation: 1通目は2月の業務に対する請求が未払いであると伝え、支払いを求める内容である。料金改定・入金確認・割引の案内ではない。
subQuestions.translation: 1通目のメールの目的は何ですか。

subQuestions.question: According to the first email, what happened on April 1?

choices.text: The invoice was issued to Mr. Tanaka
The company's banking details changed
A late fee was added to the invoice
The consulting services were completed

subQuestions.explanation: 1通目に「our banking details changed on April 1」と明記されている。延滞料は4月15日以降、業務は2月、請求書発行は3月3日。
subQuestions.translation: 1通目のメールによると、4月1日に何が起きましたか。

subQuestions.question: Why does Mr. Tanaka believe the late fee should not apply?

choices.text: He has already paid the two percent fee
His company sent the payment before the original deadline
He was never informed about the invoice
The consulting work was finished late

subQuestions.explanation: 2通目で「the original payment was made before the stated deadline」と述べている。1通目の期限は3月31日で、送金は3月28日である。
subQuestions.translation: Tanakaさんはなぜ延滞料が適用されるべきでないと考えていますか。

subQuestions.question: What problem is suggested by the two emails together?

choices.text: The payment may have been sent to an account that is no longer used
The invoice was issued for the wrong amount
Mr. Tanaka never received the original invoice
The consulting services were never delivered

subQuestions.explanation: 1通目で口座が4月1日に変わったと伝えられ、2通目では請求書記載の口座へ3月28日に送金したとある。旧口座へ送られた可能性が問題である。
subQuestions.translation: 2通のメールから示唆される問題は何ですか。

subQuestions.question: What does Mr. Tanaka ask Ms. Mbeki to do?

choices.text: Send a revised invoice with a new total
Extend the deadline by two additional weeks
Provide a receipt for the late fee
Verify whether the earlier transfer arrived

subQuestions.explanation: 2通目で「Could you confirm whether that transfer reached you?」と依頼している。請求書の再発行・期限延長・領収書の要求ではない。
subQuestions.translation: TanakaさんはMbekiさんに何をするよう求めていますか。

passages.text:
Riverside Community Center — Spring Workshop Series

All workshops are held in the Maple Room and last ninety minutes.

Saturday, May 4, 10:00 a.m. — Introduction to Container Gardening (Instructor: Dana Whitfield)
Saturday, May 11, 10:00 a.m. — Basic Home Repairs (Instructor: Luis Ferrero)
Saturday, May 18, 2:00 p.m. — Digital Photography for Beginners (Instructor: Amara Osei)
Saturday, May 25, 2:00 p.m. — Everyday Cooking on a Budget (Instructor: Dana Whitfield)

Members pay $12 per workshop; non-members pay $20. Registration closes three days before each session. Space is limited to twenty participants.

Subject: Workshop on the 18th

Hello,

I would like to attend the photography workshop later this month. I am not a member of the community center, but my partner is, and we would both like to register.

One question about the schedule: I finish work at 1:30 p.m. on Saturdays and the center is a twenty-minute walk from my office. Will latecomers still be admitted? I would rather not take a seat if arriving a few minutes late means missing the introduction.

Thank you,
Priya Raman

subQuestions.question: What is indicated about the workshop series?

choices.text: Each session is taught by a different instructor
Sessions are held on weekdays
Each session is the same length
All sessions begin at the same hour

subQuestions.explanation: 掲示に「last ninety minutes」と全共通で書かれている。開始時刻は10時と14時があり、Whitfieldは2回担当し、開催は土曜である。
subQuestions.translation: ワークショップ series について何が示されていますか。

subQuestions.question: By when must someone register for the May 18 workshop?

choices.text: May 17
May 18
May 15
May 11

subQuestions.explanation: 「Registration closes three days before each session」より、5月18日の3日前＝5月15日である。
subQuestions.translation: 5月18日のワークショップにはいつまでに登録する必要がありますか。

subQuestions.question: How much will Ms. Raman most likely pay in total to register herself and her partner?
subQuestions.explanation: Ramanさんは非会員（20ドル）、パートナーは会員（12ドル）で、2人分を登録するため合計32ドルである。24ドルは2人とも会員、40ドルは2人とも非会員とした場合の額。
subQuestions.translation: Ramanさんは自分とパートナーの登録に合計いくら支払うと考えられますか。

subQuestions.question: What concern does Ms. Raman raise about the session she selected?

choices.text: She may arrive after it has started
The room may be too small for her group
The instructor may change before the session
The fee may increase for non-members

subQuestions.explanation: 仕事が13時30分に終わり徒歩20分かかるため、14時開始の回に遅れる可能性を心配している。
subQuestions.translation: Ramanさんは選んだ回についてどんな懸念を示していますか。

subQuestions.question: Who teaches more than one workshop in the series?

choices.text: Luis Ferrero
Amara Osei
Priya Raman
Dana Whitfield

subQuestions.explanation: 掲示で5月4日と5月25日の2回をWhitfieldが担当している。
subQuestions.translation: このシリーズで2回以上担当している講師は誰ですか。

Subject: Q3 Equipment Requests

Team leads,

Please submit your equipment requests for the third quarter by June 20. Each department has been allocated a budget of $9,000. Requests above that amount require written justification and will be reviewed by the finance committee, which meets on the first Monday of each month.

As a reminder, laptop replacements on a three-year cycle do not count against your departmental budget; they are handled centrally. Furniture, software licenses, and specialized tools do count.

Thank you,
Helen Vos
Director of Operations

Q3 Equipment Request — Design Department
Submitted by: Omar Haddad
Date: June 18

1. Two graphics tablets — $2,400
2. Color-calibrated monitor — $1,900
3. Annual license, illustration software (4 seats) — $3,200
4. Replacement laptop for M. Chen (purchased 2022) — $1,700
5. Adjustable desk — $1,100

Total listed: $10,300

Note: Item 4 is a scheduled replacement.

Subject: RE: Q3 Equipment Requests — Design

Omar,

Thank you for submitting early. I have reviewed your form and one item does not belong in the departmental total, so the amount charged to your budget is lower than the figure you listed. As it stands, your request does not need to go to the committee.

I will approve it today. Please hold the desk order until July 1, when the new quarter opens.

Helen

subQuestions.question: What is the main purpose of the first email?

choices.text: To introduce a new laptop replacement cycle
To explain how to submit requests for the coming quarter
To announce an increase in departmental budgets
To report the results of a finance committee meeting

subQuestions.explanation: 1通目は提出期限・予算枠・超過時の扱いを説明する案内である。増額の告知・委員会の結果報告・新方針の導入ではない。
subQuestions.translation: 1通目のメールの主な目的は何ですか。

subQuestions.question: Which item on the form does NOT count against the design department budget?

choices.text: The illustration software license
The adjustable desk
The replacement laptop
The color-calibrated monitor

subQuestions.explanation: 1通目に「laptop replacements on a three-year cycle do not count against your departmental budget」とあり、フォームの項目4は予定された交換である。
subQuestions.translation: フォームのどの項目が設計部門の予算に計上されませんか。

subQuestions.question: What amount will actually be charged to the design department?
subQuestions.explanation: フォームの合計10,300ドルからノートPC交換の1,700ドルを除くと8,600ドルで、予算9,000ドル以内に収まる。
subQuestions.translation: 設計部門に実際に計上される金額はいくらですか。

subQuestions.question: Why does Ms. Vos say the request will not go to the committee?

choices.text: Mr. Haddad provided written justification
The chargeable total stays within the allocated budget
The request was submitted before the deadline
The committee does not meet during the third quarter

subQuestions.explanation: 委員会審査は予算超過時の手続きである。除外項目を差し引くと枠内に収まるため審査が不要になる。早期提出や理由書は条件ではない。
subQuestions.translation: Vosさんはなぜこの申請が委員会に回らないと述べていますか。

subQuestions.question: What does Ms. Vos ask Mr. Haddad to postpone?

choices.text: Submitting the request form
Replacing Mr. Chen’s laptop
Renewing the software license
Ordering the desk

subQuestions.explanation: 3通目で「Please hold the desk order until July 1」と依頼している。他の項目の延期には触れていない。
subQuestions.translation: VosさんはHaddadさんに何を延期するよう求めていますか。

passages.text:
Northgate Serviced Offices — Now Leasing

Suite A — 45 sq m, second floor, no window. $1,400/month.
Suite B — 60 sq m, third floor, corner windows. $2,050/month.
Suite C — 60 sq m, first floor, street entrance, large front-facing windows. $1,850/month.
Suite D — 95 sq m, third floor, corner windows. $2,900/month.

All suites include high-speed internet, weekly cleaning, and access to two shared meeting rooms. Parking is available for an extra $90 per space per month. Minimum lease: twelve months. Suites on the third floor are reached by stairs only.

Subject: Office space inquiry

Hello,

My translation agency is relocating in September. We are four people and expect to add one more next year, so roughly 60 square meters would suit us. Natural light matters to us — we spend the whole day reading.

Two constraints: one of our translators uses a wheelchair, so a step-free entrance is essential, and we will need two parking spaces.

Could you confirm which suite you would recommend and the total monthly cost including parking?

Regards,
Sofia Lindqvist
Lindqvist Language Services

subQuestions.question: What is included in the price of every suite?

choices.text: Furniture for four people
Weekly cleaning service
Two reserved parking spaces
A private meeting room

subQuestions.explanation: 広告に「include high-speed internet, weekly cleaning, and access to two shared meeting rooms」とある。駐車場は別料金、会議室は共用である。
subQuestions.translation: すべてのスイートの料金に含まれるものは何ですか。

subQuestions.question: Which suite best meets all of Ms. Lindqvist’s stated requirements?

choices.text: Suite D
Suite C
Suite A
Suite B

subQuestions.explanation: 60平米・自然光・段差なしの入口が条件。BとDは3階で階段のみ、Aは窓なし。1階で street entrance のCが唯一すべてを満たす。
subQuestions.translation: Lindqvistさんの条件をすべて満たすスイートはどれですか。

subQuestions.question: What would the total monthly cost be for the recommended suite with parking?
subQuestions.explanation: Suite Cの1,850ドルに駐車場2台分（90ドル×2＝180ドル）を加えて2,030ドルである。
subQuestions.translation: 推奨されるスイートに駐車場を加えた月額の合計はいくらですか。

subQuestions.question: Why are the third-floor suites unsuitable for the agency?

choices.text: They can be reached only by stairs
They are smaller than the agency needs
They do not include internet access
They are not available until next year

subQuestions.explanation: 広告に「Suites on the third floor are reached by stairs only」とあり、車椅子利用者がいるため条件に合わない。
subQuestions.translation: なぜ3階のスイートはこの事務所に適さないのですか。

subQuestions.question: In the email, the word “constraints” is closest in meaning to

choices.text: limitations
preferences
expenses
deadlines

subQuestions.explanation: 段差なしの入口と駐車場2台は「譲れない制約」として挙げられている。好み・費用・期限ではない。
subQuestions.translation: メール中の constraints に最も意味が近いのは

passages.text:
Vendor Notice — Warehouse Transition

Between August 5 and August 16, our distribution operations will move from the Eastport warehouse to the larger Kellerman facility. During this period:

• Orders placed before August 5 will ship from Eastport on the original schedule.
• Orders placed between August 5 and August 16 will be held and shipped from Kellerman starting August 19.
• Express delivery will be unavailable for the entire transition period.

We expect a two- to three-business-day delay for orders placed during the window. Standard shipping rates will not change.

Subject: Order 77-3120

Hello,

I placed order 77-3120 on August 8 and selected express delivery at checkout, but the confirmation page showed standard shipping instead. The order is for display materials we need for a trade fair that opens on August 26.

Could you tell me when the shipment will actually leave your facility, and whether it will arrive in time? If there is any risk of it arriving after the 24th, I would rather cancel and source locally.

Thanks,
Greg Okafor
Okafor Displays

subQuestions.question: What is the notice mainly about?

choices.text: A permanent increase in shipping rates
The closing of the company’s only warehouse
A new express delivery service
A temporary change in how orders are shipped

subQuestions.explanation: 倉庫移転に伴う一時的な出荷方法の変更を知らせる内容である。料金は変わらず、倉庫は移転先があり、速達は逆に停止する。
subQuestions.translation: この通知は主に何についてですか。

subQuestions.question: Why did Mr. Okafor’s order not include express delivery?

choices.text: His order was too large for express shipping
Express delivery is offered only to new customers
Express delivery was suspended during the transition
He placed the order after the trade fair deadline

subQuestions.explanation: 通知に「Express delivery will be unavailable for the entire transition period」とあり、8月8日はその期間内である。
subQuestions.translation: Okaforさんの注文に速達が付かなかったのはなぜですか。

subQuestions.question: When will order 77-3120 most likely ship?

choices.text: After August 26
On or shortly after August 19
On August 8
Before August 5

subQuestions.explanation: 8月5日〜16日の注文はKellermanから8月19日以降に出荷される。8月8日の注文はこの区分に入る。
subQuestions.translation: 注文77-3120はいつ出荷されると考えられますか。

subQuestions.question: What does Mr. Okafor say he will do if the shipment arrives too late?

choices.text: Postpone his company’s trade fair booth
Request that the order ship from Eastport
Cancel the order and buy the materials nearby
Ask for a refund of the express delivery fee

subQuestions.explanation: メールで「I would rather cancel and source locally」と述べている。返金要求・出展延期・出荷元の指定ではない。
subQuestions.translation: 配送が遅すぎる場合、Okaforさんは何をすると述べていますか。

subQuestions.question: What is suggested about the delay for orders placed during the window?

choices.text: It will apply to orders placed before August 5
It will be longer for standard shipping
It cannot be estimated at this time
It is expected to be a few business days

subQuestions.explanation: 通知に「a two- to three-business-day delay for orders placed during the window」とある。8月5日以前の注文は通常どおり出荷される。
subQuestions.translation: 該当期間の注文の遅れについて何が示唆されていますか。
